_about: Rocketbox's cheek colour in its own textures (CIELAB, median over each face's cheeks, faces with a certain ancestry label and clean skin; tools/unity/people/data/rocketbox_ancestry.json, rocketbox_ages.json skin_out) beside the same peoples' measured cheeks (Core SkinColour.Lab at Bodies.Tone and Undertone). 'fit': texture = a + b * measured, per channel, weighted by sqrt(n), over the peoples with 4 or more faces; retone.py puts a target people's measured cheek on the textures' scale with it.
